headline: Starlink access in Ukraine restored after reported Musk-ordered slowdown
summary: A report said Elon Musk ordered SpaceX to throttle Starlink access in Ukraine, which Musk and Trump both denied having ordered, with the Wall Street Journal attributing it to Musk. Starlink service in Ukraine now appears to be working normally again.

claims.statement: Elon Musk reportedly ordered SpaceX to throttle Starlink access in Ukraine.

sources.quote: Elon Musk reportedly ordered SpaceX to throttle Ukraine's Starlink access.
